spans.s:
मल् मल्, cl. 1. A., 10. P. मलते, मल-
यति or मलापयति, to hold, possess.

मल्ल् मल्ल् (allied to rt. मल्), cl. 1. A.
मल्लते, &c., to hold, have.
मलि, इस्, f. holding, having, possession.
मलि मलि. See p. 750, col. 3.

मल्लि मल्लि, इस्, m. (fr. rt. मल्ल्), having,
holding; N. of the nineteenth Arhat of the present
Ava-sarpiṇī; (also ई), f. (= मल्लिका), Jasminum
Zambac; [cf. भूरि-म्˚, मधु-मल्ली.]
—मल्लि-
गन्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, smelling like Jasminum Zambac;
(इ), n. a kind of Agallochum.
—मल्लि-नाथ, अस्, m.,
N. of a poet and celebrated commentator on the
Raghu-vaṃśa, Kumāra-sambhava, Megha-dūta, Śiśu-
pāla-badha, and Kirātārjunīya, (he probably lived in
about the fourteenth or fifteenth century.)
—मल्लि-
पत्त्र, अम्, n. a mushroom or fungus.
—मल्लि-
भूषण-देव, अस्, m., N. of a man.
मल्ली मल्ली. See under मल्लि, col. 1.

मालि, इस्, इस्, इ, (at the end of comps.) wreathed,
garlanded, crowned [cf. सु-म्˚]; (इस्), m., N. of a
son of the Rākṣasa Su-keśa.

मल मल, अम्, n. (also in some senses अस्,
m.; perhaps connected with rt. म्लै; in Uṇādi-s.
1. 109, said to be fr. rt. मृज्, the penultimate and
final being rejected and अल added), dirt, filth, dust,
impurity, any impure matter, excrement, refuse, sedi-
ment, dregs, scum, alloy or dross of metal, rust;
moral impurity, taint, sin; (with Śaivas) original
sin, natural impurity, (usually अस्, m.); the secretions
of the Dhātus (described in medical works as phlegm
from chyle, bile from the blood, nose-mucus and
ear-wax from the flesh, perspiration from the fat,
nails and hair from the bones, gum or rheum of the
eye from the brain, &c.; according to Manu

,
the twelve मलाः or impure excretions of the body
are as follow, वसा, शुक्र, असृज्, मज्जा, मूत्र,
विष्, घ्राण-विष्, कर्ण-विष्, श्लेष्मन्, अश्रु,
दूषिका, स्वेद, adeps, semen, blood, dandruff,
urine, feces, mucus of the nose, ear-wax, phlegm,
tears, rheum, and sweat); brass or a kind of metal
inferior to lead, (in this sense only अम्, n.); cam-
phor; cuttle-fish bone, Ossa Sepiæ; tanned leather,
a leather garment, (this is thought to be the meaning
of मल in Ṛg-veda

); (आ), f. Flacourtia
[]
Cataphracta; (अस्, आ, अम्), dirty, mean, niggardly,
covetous; unbelieving, godless; [cf. Gr. μέλα-ς,
μελαίν-ω, μολύν-ω, μόρον, μάρμαρος, μαρμαίρω:
Lat. malu-s, mal-itia, mali-gn-us, male-ficu-s:
Goth. mail, ‘a wrinkle:’ Old Germ. meil, ‘a
spot:’ Angl. Sax. smere, smerian, smerwian, smy-
rian: Lith. móli-s, ‘loam;’ mélyna-s, ‘blue.’]
—मल-कर्षण, अस्, ई, अम्, removing dirt,
cleansing filth, detergent.
—मल-कूट, N. of a
country.
—मल-कोष्ठक, अस्, m., N. of a man;
[cf. मल्ल-कोष्टक.]
—मल-ग, अस्, m., Ved.
(perhaps) a fuller, washerman.
—मल-ग्रहि, see
Vopa-deva
XXVI. 48

.
—मल-घ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, re-
moving dirt, freeing from spots or dirt, cleansing,
detergent; (अस्), m. the bulbous root of Salmalia
Malabarica (शाल्मली; cf. मल-हन्तृ); (ई), f. a
species of shrub (= नाग-दमनी).
—मल-ज, अस्,
आ, अम्, arising from filth or dirt, produced from dirt
or dregs; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people [cf. मलक,
मलद, मलय]; (अम्), n. purulent matter, pus.
—मल-त्व, अम्, n. dirtiness, filthiness, impurity.
—मल-दिग्धाङ्ग (˚ध-अङ्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, having
the limbs defiled with dirt, having the body soiled
with dust.
—मल-दूषित, अस्, आ, अम्, soiled with
dirt, dirty, filthy, foul.
—मल-द्रव, अस्, m.
‘liquefaction of the feces,’ diarrhœa, purging.
—म-
ल-द्राविन्, ई, इणी, इ, dissolving impurity, purging;
(ई), m. Croton Jamalgota (= जय-पाल).
—मल-
धात्री, f. ‘dirt-nurse,’ a nurse who attends to a
child's necessities.
—मल-धारिन्, ई, m. a religious
mendicant, especially one of the Jaina sect.
—मल-
पङ्किन्, ई, इनी, इ, covered with dust and mire.
—मल-पू, ऊस्, f. Ficus Oppositifolia [cf. मल-
यू]; (उ?), n. (said to) = शृङ्गी and नल.
—मल-
पृष्ठ, अम्, n. ‘dust-page,’ the outer or first
page of a book (left unwritten because liable to be
dirtied).
—मल-भुज्, क्, क्, क्, feeding on impurity,
eating filth; (क्), m. a crow.
—मल-भेदिनी, f. a
species of plant (= कटुका).
—मल-मल्लक, अम्,
n. a piece of cloth passing between the legs and
covering the privities (= कौपीन).
—मलमल्-
लक-शेष, अस्, आ, अम्, having nothing left but a
small piece of cloth to cover the privities.
—मल-
मास, अस्, m. an intercalary month, an intercalated
thirteenth month (in which no religious ceremonies
should be performed).
—मलमास-तत्त्व, अम्,
n., N. of a part of the Smṛti-tattva.
—मल-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, covered with dirt, containing impurity,
dirty, filthy.
—मलवद्-वासस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, wearing
dirty or impure clothes; (आस्), f. a menstruous
woman; [cf. मलोद्वासस्.]
—मल-वाहिन्, ई, इनी,
इ, carrying filth or soil, flowing with impurity, bear-
ing or containing dirt.
—मल-विनाशिनी, f. ‘dirt-
destroyer’ (= शङ्ख-पुष्पी), a species of plant.
—मल-विशोधन, अस्, ई, अम्, cleansing away
filth, washing away impurities.
—मल-विसर्ग, अस्,
m. or मल-विसर्जन, अम्, n. the act of removing
dirt, cleansing away filth, evacuation of the feces,
discharging the bowels, purging.
—मल-शुद्धि,
इस्, f. clearing away of feculent matter, evacuation of
the bowels.
—मल-हन्तृ, ता, m. the bulbous root
of the Salmalia Malabarica; [cf. मल-घ्न.]
—मल-हा, f., N. of a daughter of Raudrāśva.
—मल-हारक, अस्, इका, अम्, taking away impu-
rity, removing sin.
—मलाकर्षिन् (˚ल-आक्˚), ई, m.
‘dirt-remover,’ a sweeper, scavenger.
—मलापकर्-
षण (˚ल-अप्˚), अम्, n. the act of removing dirt
or impurity, purification, cleaning, cleansing; re-
moval of sin.
—मलापहा (˚ल-अप्˚), f., N. of a
river.
—मलाभ (˚ल-आभ), अस्, आ, अम्, dirty-
looking.
—मलारि (˚ल-अरि), इस्, m. ‘dirt-enemy,’ a
kind of natron (see सर्व-क्षार).
—मलावरोध
(˚ल-अव्˚), अस्, m. obstruction of the feces, constipa-
tion of the bowels.
—मलावह (˚ल-आव्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, bringing or causing defilement, soiling, dirty-
ing; defiling, disgracing.
—मलाशय (˚ल-आश्˚),
अस्, m. ‘receptacle of feculent matter,’ the belly.
—मलोत्सर्ग (˚ल-उत्˚), अस्, m. evacuation of the
feces, purging of the bowels.
—मलोद्वासस् (˚ल-
उद्˚), आस्, f. a woman who has put off her soiled
clothes (after her period of impurity).

मल्ल मल्ल, अस्, m. a wrestler or boxer by
profession, (the offspring of an outcast Kṣatriya by a
Kṣatriya female, cf. Manu
XII. 45

); an athlete,
a very strong man; N. of various men; epithet of a
king named Nārāyaṇa; N. of the twenty-first Arhat
of the future Utsarpiṇī; a vessel for drinking, vessel,
cup; the cheek and temple, the hemicranium; the
remnant of an oblation; a kind of fish, = कपालिन्;
(आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; (आ), f. a woman;
Arabian jasmine [cf. मल्लिक]; ornamenting the
person with coloured unguents (= पत्त्र-वल्ली); N.
of two women; (अस्, आ, अम्), strong, stout, athletic,
robust; good, excellent.
—मल्ल-कोष्ट or मल्ल-
कोष्टक, अस्, m. a proper N.
—मल्ल-क्रीडा, f. a
wrestling or boxing match, athletic sports.
—मल्ल-
घटी, f. a kind of dancing or pantomimic gesture
(= नाट्य-विशेष).
—मल्ल-ज, अम्, n. black pepper.
—मल्ल-तूर्य, अम्, n. a kind of drum beaten
during a wrestling match.
—मल्ल-देव, अस्, m., N.
[]
of the author of the Kāla-jñāna, a medical work.
—मल्ल-द्वादशि, f., N. of the twelfth day in
a particular half month.
—मल्लद्वादशी-व्रत,
अम्, n., N. of a particular religious observance.
—मल्ल-नाग, अस्, m. a N. of Vātsyāyana, author
of the Kāma-sūtras (a work on amorous topics);
Indra's elephant; a letter-carrier.
—मल्ल-पुर or
मल्ला-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a city.
—मल्ल-बन्-
धान्तर (˚ध-अन्˚), a particular posture with
wrestlers.
—मल्ल-भू, ऊस्, f. a wrestling ground,
place for athletic contests, a palæstra or arena; the
site of any conflict, a field of battle.
—मल्ल-भूमि,
इस्, f. a wrestling ground, arena for athletic contests;
N. of a country.
—मल्ल-यात्रा, f. a train or pro-
cession of wrestlers, a wrestling match.
—मल्ल-
युद्ध, अम्, n. ‘a prize-fight,’ pugilistic encounter,
wrestling or boxing match, athletic contest.
—मल्ल-
राष्ट्र, अम्, n., N. of a kingdom.
—मल्ल-वास्तु,
उ, n., N. of a place, see Pāṇ.

; [cf. माल्-
लवास्तव.]
—मल्ल-विद्या, f. the art of boxing or
wrestling.
—मल्ल-वेश, अस्, m. a wrestler's dress.
—मल्ल-शाला, f. a room for wrestling or boxing,
wrestling place, gymnasium.
—मल्लारि (˚ल-अरि),
इस्, m. ‘the enemy of the Asura Malla,’ an epithet of
Kṛṣṇa; of Śiva; N. of a commentator on the
Graha-lāghava (his commentary appears to be called
Mallārī).
—मल्लारि-माहात्म्य, अम्, n., N. of a
portion of the Adhyātma-rāmāyaṇa.
—मल्लार्जुन
(˚ल-अर्˚), अस्, m., N. of a king.
—मल्लासुर, अस्,
m. the Asura Malla, N. of an Asura.

माल माल, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 3. मा),
N. of a district (lying west and south-west of Ben-
gal); a barbarian or mountaineer of a particular
tribe; an epithet of Viṣṇu; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a
barbarous tribe of people; (आ), f. a wreath, garland,
chaplet, crown; a row, line (= पङ्क्ति, Kirātārju-
nīya

); a chain, string, rosary, necklace [cf.
अक्ष-म्˚]; a collection, group [cf. नक्षत्र-म्˚];
a series, regular succession, (नाम्नाम् माला, a col-
lection of words arranged in order, a vocabulary, dic-
tionary; cf. नाम-म्˚); (in rhetoric) a series of
epithets, a string of similes; (in the drama) the
offering of many things to obtain a wish; a streak,
(तडिन्-माला, a flash of lightning); N. of a river;
of a lexicon; of a metre containing two lines of
¯¯˘¯¯˘˘¯˘¯¯ and two of ˘¯˘¯¯˘˘¯˘
¯¯ of another metre, four times ˘˘˘˘˘˘,
˘˘˘˘˘˘˘˘¯ [cf. स्रज्]; of a Prākṛt metre of
twice 45 and 43+27 instants; (अम्), n. a field, a
forest or wood near a village; deceit, fraud, artifice;
(अस्, आ, अम्), low, base.
—माल-चक्रक, अम्, n.
the hip-joint.
—माल-भञ्जिका, f. (माल for माला),
‘breaking the garland,’ N. of a game.
—माल-भा-
रिन्, ई, इणी, इ (माल for माला), bearing or wearing
a garland, having a chaplet or crown, garlanded.
—माला-कण्ठ, अस्, m. the plant Achyranthes As-
pera.
—माला-कन्द, अस्, m. a species of bulbous
plant.
—माला-कर or माला-कार, अस्, m. a wreath-
maker, garland-weaver, florist, gardener; the mixed
caste of gardeners; N. of a son of Viśva-karman by
a Śūdra woman or by Ghṛtācī; (ई), f. a woman
[]
who weaves garlands, a wreath-maker.
—माला-कुट-
दन्ती, f., N. of a Rākṣasī.
—माला-गुण, अस्, m.
the string of a garland, a necklace.
—मालागुण-
परिक्षिप्ता, f. ‘invested with the marriage string,’
a marriageable woman.
—माला-गुणा, f., scil. लूता,
a species of venomous spider.
—माला-ग्रन्थि, इस्,
m. = माला-दूर्वा, q. v.
—मालाङ्क (˚ला-अङ्˚), अस्,
m., N. of a king (the author of a commentary on
the Mālatī-mādhava, and of the Vṛndā-vana).
—मा-
ला-तृण or मालातृणक, अम्, n. a fragrant grass,
Andropogon Schœnanthus.
—माला-दीपक, अम्, n.
(in rhetoric) a particular figure of speech, a closely
linked or connected climax.
—माला-दूर्वा, f. a
species of Dūrvā grass.
—माला-धर, अस्, ई, अम्,
having or wearing a garland, wearing a chaplet or
crown, crowned; N. of a class of divine beings; N.
of a man; (ई), f., N. of a Rākṣasī; (अम्), n. a
species of the Aty-aṣṭi metre, four times ˘˘˘˘˘
¯˘¯˘˘˘¯˘¯¯˘¯.
—माला-प्रस्थ, अस्, m.,
N. of a city.
—माला-फल, अम्, n. the seed of
Elæocarpus Ganitrus (employed for rosaries).
—माला-
मनु, उस्, m., Ved. or माला-मन्त्र, अस्, m. a
sacred text or saying written in the form of a wreath.
—माला-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of garlands; con-
sisting of lines or streaks in regular succession.
—मालारिष्टा (˚ला-अर्˚), f. a species of plant (=
पाची).
—मालालिका or मालाली (˚ल-आल्˚), f. Trigo-
nella Corniculata.
—माला-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having
a wreath or garland, garlanded, wreathed, crowned;
(अती), f., N. of the wife of Upa-barhaṇa; of the
wife of Kuśa-dhvaja.
—मालोपमा (˚ला-उप्˚), f.
‘string of comparisons,’ a particular figure in rhetoric
(e. g. ‘heroism adds glory to thy character, as heat to
the sun, the sun to the day, the day to the sky’).
माला माला. See under माल, p. 774.

माल्ल माल्ल, अस्, m. (fr. मल्ल), N. of a
particular mixed caste.

मलिन, अस्, आ, अम्, dirty, foul, filthy, impure,
soiled, unclean; stained, tarnished, rusty, sullied,
tainted; morally impure, sinful, depraved, vile, bad;
dark, obscure, obscured, clouded, beclouded (as the
intellect); of a dark colour, dark, dark gray, brown,
black; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Taṃsu (according to
some Anila); (आ or ई), f. a woman during menstrua-
tion; (अम्), n. sin, fault, defect; buttermilk; borax.
—मलिन-ता, f. or मलिन-त्व, अम्, n. dirtiness,
foulness, filthiness, impurity, moral impurity, sinful-
ness, wickedness, blackness, moral blackness.
—म-
लिन-प्रभ, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘whose light is obscured,’
obscured, clouded.
—मलिन-मुख, अस्, आ or ई,
अम्, ‘dirty-faced, black-faced, dark-faced,’ vulgar,
low, vile, wicked; cruel, fierce, savage; (अस्), m.
fire; a kind of ape (= गो-लाङ्गूल); a departed
spirit, ghost, apparition, evil spirit (= प्रेत).
—म-
लिनाम्बु (˚न-अम्˚), उ, n. ‘black-fluid,’ ink.
—म-
लिनास्य (˚न-आस्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘dirty-faced, dark-
faced,’ vulgar, low; savage, cruel, ferocious.
—म-
लिनी-करण, अम्, n. the act of making dirty, soiling,
staining, making impure; an action which defiles.
—मलिनी-करणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, fitted to cause
pollution, occasioning defilement (Manu

).
—मलिनी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-
तुम्, to make dirty, soil, stain; to darken, make
obscure.
—मलिनी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवि-
तुम्, to be or become dirty.
मलिन मलिन. See col. 2.

मलिनय, Nom. P. मलिनयति, -यितुम्, to
soil, make dirty, defile, stain, tarnish.

मलिनित, अस्, आ, अम्, dirtied, soiled, tarnished,
defiled; tainted, corrupted, wicked.

मलिनिमन्, आ, m. dirtiness, filthiness, impurity,
blackness, darkness.

मलिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, excessively dirty, filthy;
(आ), f. a woman during menstruation, menstruous.

मलीमस, अस्, आ, अम्, dirty, unclean, foul, im-
pure, soiled, stained, sinful, wicked; dark, of a dark
or dirty gray colour; (अस्), m. iron; vitriol of iron,
green vitriol.

मलीयस्, आन्, असी, अस्, excessively dirty, filthy;
very sinful, wicked.

मलद मलद, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people
[cf. मलक, मलज, मलय]; (आ), f., N. of a
daughter of Raudrāśva, (also मलन्दा.)

मालद मालद, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people;
(also read मानद.)

मलन मलन, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt.
मल्), a tent; (अम्), n. crushing, grinding (= मर्-
दन).

मलप्रालदेश मलप्राल-देश, अस्, m., N. of
a country.
—मलप्राल-देशीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belong-
ing to or a native of Malaprāla-deśa.

मलबार मलबार, the country Malabar.
—मलबार-देश, अस्, m. the Malabar country.

मलय मलय, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt.
मल्, Uṇādi-s.
IV. 99

), N. of a mountainous range
in Malabar, the western Ghāts in the Dekkan (these
mountains abound in sandal trees); the country that
lies to the east of the Malaya range, Malabar; N. of
a son of Garuḍa, (also read मालय); N. of a son
of Ṛṣabha; a garden; a celestial grove, = नन्दन-
वन; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; of a country
(= शैलांश-देश); one of the minor Dvīpas or
divisions of the world; (आ), f. Ipomœa Turpethum;
N. of a woman.
—मलय-केतु, उस्, m., N. of a
prince.
—मलय-गन्धिनी, f., N. of a Vidyā-dharī;
of a companion of Umā.
—मलय-गिरि, इस्, m. the
Malaya mountains in Malabar answering to the
western Ghāts; a district in the south of India; N.
of a commentator on the Jīvābhigama-sūtra.
—म-
लय-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, growing on the Malaya moun-
tain; (अस्), m. a sandal tree; (अस्, अम्), m. n.
sandal-wood, sandal; (अम्), n. epithet of Rāhu.
—मलयज-रजस्, अस्, n. the dust of sandal.
